en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a wide boulevard lined with ornate 19th‑century buildings. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing and some horse-drawn vehicles move along the street. A large building dominates the scene with a rooftop advertisement reading "HUNTER WHISKY." In the foreground is an ornate kiosk or small pavilion. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location as Andrássy út in Budapest in both Hungarian and German.
